name: handshake-net-store
title: Handshake rows, reserved event ids, and the per-save store's directory and flush

steps.note: Evidence 212 (J19). Two of these lines are written at plugin ATTACH, not by a command, so they are matched against the whole log ring rather than this run's window: if the Sample was loaded long enough ago for them to fall out of the 4000-line ring, they fail for that reason and not for a defect - reload the Sample and run the case again.

steps.expectLog: Sample handshake: declared \d+ row\(s\) on the server side costing \d+ of \d+ slot\(s\)
Sample net: own event ids 0x536D4E70 \('SmNp'\) and 0x536D4E72 \('SmNr'\) reserved=False/False

steps.note: .hs itself replies in chat only, and a ghost has no chat slot, so it is run for the code path and asserted through the attach line above (evidence 212 read the reply with a real user).

steps.expectLog: Sample net: 0x50726848 is RESERVED: CustomEvents\.IsReservedEventId says yes
Sample net: 0x536D4E70 is free: CustomEvents\.IsReservedEventId says no
Sample store: ModSave\.CurrentSaveDirectory = .+ \| this plugin's JSON: .+progenitor\.sample\.json

steps.note: The flush writes this plugin's JSON beside the world save - the one write this case makes, and the same one evidence 212 made by hand.

steps.expectLog: Sample store: ModSave\.SaveAll\(\) wrote .+progenitor\.sample\.json \(\d+ byte\(s\), \d+ key\(s\) in memory\)
